show_image_tensor: display a PyTorch tensor image with custom mean and std normalization using matplotlib
show_video_clip: display a video clip tensor as a grid of frames using matplotlib subplots
show_image_custom_normalization: show an image tensor with custom mean and std values for denormalization before display
show_video_multirow: display a video clip tensor across multiple rows using the nrow parameter
